summary: Digital Brands Group filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with 1800 Diagonal Lending, LLC for a $238,050 promissory note with $13,050 original issue discount, priced at $207,000, and additional tranches of up to $1,015,000 subject to agreement. The note bears 12% interest, requires nine monthly payments of $29,624 starting July 2026, matures March 2027, and is convertible upon default at 61% of the lowest closing bid price over ten trading days. Proceeds are for working capital. No board recommendation or advisor named. Risk-arb: this private debt financing is not a special situation.
